notes: Verified A+-priority Washington, DC discovery under the current two-stage RADAR rubric after rereading docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md. The Yamamoto-first pass found no new unrecorded verified Tsuyoshi Yamamoto date. FKJ clears RADAR admission because his live identity is built around a distinctive multi-instrumental language spanning keys, guitar, saxophone, voice, looping, groove and improvisation, and this performance brings the new Tyber cycle to the local DMV domain. A+ captures the recommendation: it is excellent and actively worth making room for locally, while the same Tyber Tour plays Philadelphia on June 3 and Brooklyn on June 4 before Washington on June 7, so the opportunity is not scarce enough for S. Recent curated discoveries remain predominantly A/A+ with S reserved for genuinely rare contexts, and this grade preserves that distinction without using a quota.

events.subtitle: Tyber Tour
events.factual_description: I.M.P. presents FKJ's Tyber Tour at The Anthem in Washington, DC on Monday, June 7, 2027. Doors are at 6:30 PM and the show is at 7:30 PM. Ticketmaster independently lists the same date, time and venue. I.M.P.'s current artist text describes Tyber as FKJ's third album and a stylistically wide-ranging project moving through funk, jazz, rock, alt-pop and R&B; the record is scheduled for release on September 11, 2026. The North American routing also includes The Fillmore Philadelphia on June 3 and Brooklyn Paramount on June 4 before the Washington date.

en.why_it_matters: FKJ's live language makes the border between player, arranger and producer unusually visible: keys, guitar, saxophone, voice and looping can all become part of the same evolving groove. Tyber gives that language a fresh body of material spanning funk, jazz, rock, alt-pop and R&B, so the Anthem date has a concrete current-project reason to matter rather than functioning as a catalogue stop.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this one in the DMV if multi-instrumental performance, groove and the jazz-soul-electronic borderlands are part of the listening thread. The Anthem is an easy local priority, while nearby Philadelphia and Brooklyn dates mean there is no need to treat the Washington stop as a scarce regional one-off.

es.why_it_matters: El lenguaje en vivo de FKJ vuelve muy visible la frontera entre intérprete, arreglista y productor: teclados, guitarra, saxofón, voz y loops pueden terminar formando parte del mismo groove en movimiento. Tyber le da a ese lenguaje un cuerpo nuevo de material que cruza funk, jazz, rock, alt-pop y R&B, así que la fecha de The Anthem tiene una razón actual y concreta para importar en vez de ser una parada de catálogo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente dentro del DMV si el hilo de escucha incluye multiinstrumentismo, groove y cruces entre jazz, soul y electrónica. The Anthem la vuelve una prioridad local muy fácil de acomodar; las fechas cercanas de Filadelfia y Brooklyn evitan tratar Washington como un one-off regional escaso.
